item.description:
This release is mostly bug and crash fixing, plus a new portrait-display option.
## Cross-platform
- Add a "Rotate On Portrait Displays" option ([#623](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/623)) - Don't crash at launch when the disk is full ([#664](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/664)) - Fix a crash on large playlists by making the dream cache thread-safe and requesting metadata in batches ([#522](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/522)) - Fix a startup crash when the first uncached dream has no metadata - Avoid random sign-outs by persisting the sessions in all cases ([#656](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/656)) - Randomize download order in shuffle mode ([#521](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/521)) - Truncate long credits-overlay titles so they don't overlap the playlist index ([#520](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/520)) - Spell out the comma in the settings shortcut shown in the help overlay ([#653](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/653))
## Windows
- Fix an SSL connect error caused by a Schannel revocation hard-fail ([#655](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/655)) - Restore keyboard control for the fullscreen app on a secondary monitor ([#617](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/617)) - Fix the filtering of the text overlays for smoother font rendering ([#652](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/652))
## Mac
- Move the Help menu item into the Help menu and rename it "Infinidream Help" ([#641](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/641))
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.16.0...0.16.1
